physics_goals.value: Measure the antiquark flavor asymmetry (dbar/ubar) in the proton sea via the Drell-Yan process, and study how nuclear binding modifies the quark/antiquark structure of nucleons

summary.plain: SeaQuest was a Fermilab experiment that fired a proton beam at hydrogen and deuterium targets to measure how down and up antiquarks are distributed differently inside a proton, finishing its analysis in 2025.
summary.technical: Fixed-target Drell-Yan dimuon experiment (Fermilab E-906) in the NM4 hall, using a 120 GeV proton beam (Main Injector) on liquid-hydrogen, liquid-deuterium and solid nuclear targets to measure the proton's dbar/ubar sea-quark flavor asymmetry and nuclear modification effects; its final combined-data-set results were posted in December 2025.
